item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:45 HKT 02/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry continental airstream and the outer subsiding air of Super Typhoon Hinnamnor, it will be generally fine and persistently very hot over southeastern China in the next few days. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Hinnamnor will linger over the seas east of Taiwan today. It will then take a northward track, moving towards the vicinity of the East China Sea.
